Comparing the **[Nike Pegasus 41](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462775976734931,imageDocid:16971590013783936311,gpcid:12837924782550288304,headlineOfferDocid:11520295116910202638,catalogid:18388921758796368780,productDocid:899124480260005862,rds:PC_12837924782550288304%7CPROD_PC_12837924782550288304&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCAwQAQ)** and the **[Brooks Ghost 16](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462484170815882,imageDocid:15046292929291823102,gpcid:15878061881408084049,headlineOfferDocid:15195270342982836143,catalogid:13921717985890395884,productDocid:4360807767425830951,rds:PC_15878061881408084049%7CPROD_PC_15878061881408084049&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCAwQAg)** puts two of the most popular, workhorse neutral daily trainers head-to-head. Both sit at the **$140** price point, making them the go-to baseline options for everyday road miles, long runs, and walking.[[1]](https://runrepeat.com/nike-pegasus-41)[[2]](https://runrepeat.com/brooks-ghost-16)

### **Side-by-Side Specs** 

| | |
|---|---|
| Price $140 | Price $140 |
| Weight 9.9 oz (281g) | Weight 9.4 oz (266g) |
| Heel Stack 33.6 mm | Heel Stack 35.1 mm |
| Forefoot Stack 22.2 mm | Forefoot Stack 22.7 mm |
| Heel-to-Toe Drop 11.4 mm | Heel-to-Toe Drop 12.4 mm |
| Midsole Foam ReactX + dual Air Zoom units | Midsole Foam DNA Loft v3 |
| Best Suited For Heel/midfoot strikers, bouncy feel | Best Suited For Heel strikers, plush & steady reliability |

### **Key Differences** 

- **The Ride & Foam:** 
	- **[Pegasus 41](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462775976734931,imageDocid:16971590013783936311,gpcid:12837924782550288304,headlineOfferDocid:11520295116910202638,catalogid:18388921758796368780,productDocid:899124480260005862,rds:PC_12837924782550288304%7CPROD_PC_12837924782550288304&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQBQ)** steps up with *ReactX* foam combined with forefoot and heel *Air Zoom* units. It delivers a slightly springier, more energetic pop-off underfoot compared to older Pegasus generations.
	- **[Brooks Ghost 16](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462484170815882,imageDocid:15046292929291823102,gpcid:15878061881408084049,headlineOfferDocid:15195270342982836143,catalogid:13921717985890395884,productDocid:4360807767425830951,rds:PC_15878061881408084049%7CPROD_PC_15878061881408084049&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQBw)** uses *DNA Loft v3* (infused with nitrogen). It provides a smooth, ultra-consistent, balanced, and familiar soft ride that feels the same from mile 1 to mile 500 without a bouncy or "spring-loaded" gimmick.[[1]](https://runrepeat.com/brooks-ghost-16)[[2]](https://runrepeat.com/nike-pegasus-41)
- **Drop & Footstrike:** 
	- Both feature a traditional, high heel-to-toe drop (over 11 mm), heavily favoring **heel strikers**.
	- The [Ghost 16](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462484170815882,imageDocid:15046292929291823102,gpcid:15878061881408084049,headlineOfferDocid:15195270342982836143,catalogid:13921717985890395884,productDocid:4360807767425830951,rds:PC_15878061881408084049%7CPROD_PC_15878061881408084049&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQEA) leans into a slightly steeper traditional offset (12.4 mm), while the [Pegasus 41](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462775976734931,imageDocid:16971590013783936311,gpcid:12837924782550288304,headlineOfferDocid:11520295116910202638,catalogid:18388921758796368780,productDocid:899124480260005862,rds:PC_12837924782550288304%7CPROD_PC_12837924782550288304&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQEQ) sits right around 11.4 mm.[[1]](https://runrepeat.com/nike-pegasus-41)[[2]](https://runrepeat.com/brooks-ghost-16)
- **Upper & Lockdown:** 
	- **[Pegasus 41](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462775976734931,imageDocid:16971590013783936311,gpcid:12837924782550288304,headlineOfferDocid:11520295116910202638,catalogid:18388921758796368780,productDocid:899124480260005862,rds:PC_12837924782550288304%7CPROD_PC_12837924782550288304&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQGQ)** features a fully-gusseted, plush padded tongue that hugs the midfoot tightly and securely.
	- **[Brooks Ghost 16](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462484170815882,imageDocid:15046292929291823102,gpcid:15878061881408084049,headlineOfferDocid:15195270342982836143,catalogid:13921717985890395884,productDocid:4360807767425830951,rds:PC_15878061881408084049%7CPROD_PC_15878061881408084049&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQGw)** uses a non-gusseted traditional tongue design with a classic, accommodating upper that fits a wide variety of foot shapes comfortably right out of the box.[[1]](https://runrepeat.com/nike-pegasus-41)[[2]](https://runrepeat.com/brooks-ghost-16)
- **Weight & Agility:** 
	- The [Ghost 16](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462484170815882,imageDocid:15046292929291823102,gpcid:15878061881408084049,headlineOfferDocid:15195270342982836143,catalogid:13921717985890395884,productDocid:4360807767425830951,rds:PC_15878061881408084049%7CPROD_PC_15878061881408084049&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQIw) is marginally lighter (9.4 oz) than the [Pegasus 41](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462775976734931,imageDocid:16971590013783936311,gpcid:12837924782550288304,headlineOfferDocid:11520295116910202638,catalogid:18388921758796368780,productDocid:899124480260005862,rds:PC_12837924782550288304%7CPROD_PC_12837924782550288304&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQJA) (9.9 oz), though both feel very similar on the leg.[[1]](https://runrepeat.com/nike-pegasus-41)[[2]](https://runrepeat.com/brooks-ghost-16)

### **Which One Should You Choose?** 

- **Choose the [Nike Pegasus 41](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,imageDocid:606373445808387492,headlineOfferDocid:3015103026441804681,productDocid:3015103026441804681&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCCcQAw) if:** You want a bit more **energy return and bounce** from the ReactX foam and Air Zoom setup, prefer a locked-in gusseted tongue, and want a daily trainer that can handle a slightly faster pace when you pick things up.[[1]](https://runrepeat.com/nike-pegasus-41)
- **Choose the [Brooks Ghost 16](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462484170815882,imageDocid:12386463627953682533,gpcid:15878061881408084049,headlineOfferDocid:5661548421047023241,catalogid:10857091075101803755,productDocid:6694370890413403676,rds:PC_15878061881408084049%7CPROD_PC_15878061881408084049&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizj4zF34KYAxUShv0HHZCgB8EQxa4PeggIAggBCCcQCQ) if:** You prefer a **tried-and-true, reliable, and smooth** cruiser that prioritizes unshakeable consistency, classic stepping-in comfort, and no surprises over high-energy bounce.[[1]](https://runrepeat.com/brooks-ghost-16)

You can check out full lab breakdowns on [RunRepeat's Nike Pegasus 41 Review](https://runrepeat.com/nike-pegasus-41) and [RunRepeat's Brooks Ghost 16 Review](https://runrepeat.com/brooks-ghost-16).
